basic_info.title: RouteKG: A knowledge graph-based framework for route prediction on road networks
basic_info.authors: Yihong Tang, Zhan Zhao, Weipeng Deng, Shuyu Lei, Yuebing Liang, Zhenliang Ma
basic_info.venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems, 2025 (vol. 26, issue 12, pp. 22277-22295); preprint arXiv:2310.03617 (2023)

gap_analysis.whats_missing: RouteKG injects road-network structure via a knowledge graph (reformulating route prediction as knowledge-graph completion that encodes spatial relations / moving directions), partially addressing the semantic-enrichment pillar, but it uses KG-completion-style scoring plus a sequence encoder rather than a transformer encoder over a vectorized graph. It has no RL agent and no latent-space sequential decision-making, and is trained supervised on observed routes rather than label-free on raw GPS.
gap_analysis.reasoning: It instantiates structural/semantic enrichment of road networks (the semantic-enrichment pillar) via a KG, but the KG-completion + top-K route generation paradigm differs from a transformer encoder + latent-space RL map-matching agent, and it is not label-free.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Demonstrates that injecting road-network structural/semantic relations (directions, connectivity) via a knowledge graph improves prediction of where fleet vehicles will go, directly relevant to BMW Foresight fleet-trajectory analytics.
